Work.desc: Three projects where the hard decisions mattered more than the framework. Consistency, scale and product — with engineering evidence.

vanguarda.tagline: A core banking transfer service that never corrupts a balance.
vanguarda.summary: Account-to-account transfers built around three invariants: idempotency on retry, consistency under contention and an auditable ledger. SERIALIZABLE transactions, deterministically ordered distributed locks and double-entry entries, provisioned with Terraform on AWS.

impact.label: concurrent threads with no balance corruption

alyra.tagline: A finance and life app with an assistant that actually executes.
alyra.summary: A React Native/Expo mobile product on a FastAPI backend. The assistant uses tool calling to operate the app in natural language: 55 tools, mandatory confirmation for destructive actions and a deterministic fallback path. Google/Apple sign-in, TOTP 2FA, RevenueCat subscriptions and Cloud Run delivery with canary releases and automatic rollback.

kybernus.tagline: Open-source scaffolding for backends that matter.
kybernus.summary: A TypeScript CLI that generates NestJS, Express, Spring Boot, FastAPI and Next.js projects with clean, hexagonal or MVC architecture — plus Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and AI-generated docs. Published on npm and adopted by 100+ developers in its first month.

dayride.summary: Google Maps routing, Stripe subscriptions, installable PWA and transactional email with Resend.

trevi.tagline: Personal finance through a Telegram bot.
trevi.summary: A receipt photo becomes a transaction: Gemini OCR and NLP, a React dashboard and Postgres.

ecommerce.summary: Rotating refresh tokens in HttpOnly cookies, RBAC, Stripe webhooks and Docker deployment on AWS.

veterano.tagline: Mentorship between senior students and freshmen.
veterano.summary: Azure microfrontends with a Kong API gateway, a BFF and services on Container Apps.

wow.summary: Owning the full lifecycle of a monorepo with 5 applications that run a franchise network: POS, customer area, management panel and APIs.
bullets: Architected a provider-agnostic AI platform (NestJS + Angular) serving 80+ users and 140+ conversations/day: RAG over Notion/PDF/DOCX, tool calling with human confirmation, versioned agents and per-run auditing.

Replaced Pipefy with a native workflow engine: 18 automations migrated to TypeScript, latency from 1,628 ms to 249 ms and requests per webhook from 5 to 1; bidirectional reconciliation fixed 170+ diverging cards.
Delivered NFS-e invoicing end to end across 4 codebases and 14 locations, cutting issuance time by 90%+; A1 certificates live in memory only and one upload covers the entire CNPJ root.
Architected Google OAuth end to end (NestJS + FlutterFlow), now 80%+ of logins, with a 10-minute JWT bridge and an account-takeover guard.
Shipped a discount-campaign engine replacing Voucherify (US$650/month), an in-house contract-signing system with audit trail replacing ClickSign (R$179/month), and an AI-triaged complaints hub.

vivo.summary: Automation and data for B2B and B2C operations across southern Brazil.
bullets: Cut historical query latency by 99% for 1,200+ technicians with a Next.js + FastAPI dashboard, Rust parsers and multi-level RAM/Parquet caching.
Python/Pandas ETL pipelines with atomic table swaps: 800k+ records per month, zero downtime and 100% accuracy.
Strategic dashboard adopted by directors and managers at 4 major partners across B2B and B2C operations.
